title: Send an AGV to a selected square using Robot Selection → Go-to (Confirm) and verify AGV info updates
summary: Use the live OptiSweep interface object selection to select an AGV (cell phone/object icon) so the AGV information panel updates, then use Go-to → select a destination square → Confirm to send an AGV that is not in a task to the selected square (example recovery: drop it off at the hospital).
when_to_use: When you need to recover an AGV quickly by sending it to a chosen square using Go-to, specifically described for an AGV that is “not in a task.”
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for physical safety actions if an AGV requires on-floor intervention (the provided segment does not include physical recovery steps or safety interlocks).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the live HMI interactions (Robot Selection object selection, Go-to selection, destination square selection, and Confirm).
access_or_tools_needed: Live OptiSweep interface that includes “Robot Selection” and “Go to” controls (the segment references these UI labels).

access_required: Access to the live OptiSweep interface that contains Robot Selection and Go-to controls.
system_preconditions: The AGV you intend to send is available for Go-to use as described: “An AGV not in a task can be sent to any square.”

visual_references.description: Frame showing the Robot Selection → Go-to flow and the Confirm step; includes text: selecting the cell phone shows AGV information; Go-to can send an AGV not in a task to any square; example recovery drop-off at the hospital.

steps.title: Open the live interface and use Robot Selection to select an AGV object
steps.purpose: Select the target AGV so the interface displays AGV-specific information.
steps.instruction: Open the live OptiSweep interface that supports “Robot Selection.” Under the AGV view, select the AGV object (the segment references selecting a “cell phone” icon).
steps.expected_result: After selecting the AGV object (cell phone), the interface shows the AGV information.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV information panel populates/updates after the AGV object selection.
steps.failure_condition: Selecting the AGV object does not display/update the AGV information.
stop_or_escalate_if: If selecting the AGV does not display AGV information, stop and escalate for assistance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Now, if you're under AGV, right, And you select this cell phone, right, It'll show you the AGV information.”

steps.title: Select Go-to for the selected AGV
steps.purpose: Initiate the routing action for the selected AGV.
steps.instruction: With the AGV selected, select the “Go to” function for that AGV.
steps.expected_result: The Go-to function is selected/active for the selected AGV (ready for destination square selection).
steps.healthy_condition: Go-to selection is available/active after selecting the AGV.
steps.failure_condition: Go-to cannot be selected/confirmed as described in the segment flow.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/text lists the sequence: “Select an AGV” → “Select Go to” → “Select which square you want the AGV to go to” → “Select Confirm.”

steps.title: Select the destination square on the map/grid
steps.purpose: Choose where the AGV should be routed.
steps.instruction: Select the destination square on the map/grid for where you want the AGV to go.
steps.expected_result: The destination square selection is made (the chosen square is the target for the Go-to request).
steps.healthy_condition: A specific square is selected as the destination for the Go-to request.
steps.failure_condition: No destination square can be selected or the selected destination is not accepted by the UI flow.

actions.label: Select destination square
actions.exact_action: Select which square you want the AGV to go to

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/text lists: “Select which square you want the AGV to go to.”

steps.title: Confirm the Go-to request
steps.purpose: Submit the routing command to send the AGV to the selected square.
steps.instruction: Select “Confirm” to submit the Go-to request.
steps.expected_result: The Go-to request is submitted via Confirm.
steps.healthy_condition: Confirm submission completes and the system proceeds with the Go-to action.
steps.failure_condition: The Go-to action cannot be confirmed or the system does not accept the request.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the Go-to action cannot be confirmed, stop and escalate for assistance.
If the AGV does not reflect movement/routing toward the selected square, stop and escalate for assistance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/text lists: “Select Confirm.” Also states: “An AGV not in a task can be sent to any square… use the go to function to drop it off at the hospital.”

steps.title: Verify the AGV is routed to the selected square (recovery example: hospital drop-off)
steps.purpose: Ensure the Go-to action took effect and the AGV is being routed as intended.
steps.instruction: Observe that the AGV is now being routed to the selected square (example recovery use: drop it off at the hospital).
steps.expected_result: The interface/system reflects that the AGV is being routed to the selected square; example: hospital drop-off use case.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV routing/movement toward the selected square is reflected after Confirm.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not reflect movement/routing toward the selected square after Confirm.

actions.label: Observe routing/movement
actions.exact_action: Observe that the AGV is now being routed to the selected square

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV does not reflect movement toward the selected square, stop and escalate for assistance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/text: “use the go to function to drop it off at the hospital.” and “An AGV not in a task can be sent to any square.”

success_criteria: After selecting the AGV object (cell phone), the AGV information panel updates/shows AGV information.
After Go-to → destination square → Confirm, the system reflects that the AGV is being routed to the selected square.
healthy_conditions: AGV information panel populates after AGV object selection.
Go-to request is accepted after Confirm and routing toward the selected square is reflected.
failure_conditions: Selecting the AGV object does not display AGV information.
After Confirm, the AGV does not reflect movement/routing toward the selected square.
escalation_guidance: If AGV information does not display after selecting the AGV object, stop and escalate for assistance.
If Go-to cannot be confirmed or the AGV does not reflect movement/routing toward the selected square, stop and escalate for assistance.
